text:
**Best overall: JBL Charge 6.** It's the top pick at What Hi-Fi, BestProducts and iTechGuides. It's rated IP68 and sounds powerful and clear. It can also charge your phone. Battery life is listed as 20 hours by iTechGuides and up to 28 hours by BestProducts. It runs about $130 at Walmart and $150 at Amazon.
- Where to buy: [What Hi-Fi's list](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) and [BestProducts' list](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) both link to retailers.

**Other picks by need**
- **Small and easy to carry: JBL Grip (about $100).** Good Housekeeping's DJ tester named it best overall for the beach. It's IP68, weighs under a pound, fits in a bottle pocket and runs about 12 hours. The mesh body can collect dust. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Budget and floats: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 (about $65–80).** It gives 360-degree sound and floats, but battery life is only "good, not great." [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5 (about $40).** What Hi-Fi's best budget pick. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- **Loud pool parties: Ultimate Ears Epicboom or Sony ULT Field 5.** Tom's Guide picked the Epicboom (IP67) as best overall but notes it's pricey. It named the Sony best for pool parties. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)
- **Biggest sound: JBL Boombox 4.** It's RTINGS' best waterproof Bluetooth speaker. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)

**Care tips:** IP ratings only cover water getting in. They don't cover damage from salt or chlorine. RTINGS suggests rinsing the speaker with fresh water after use. iTechGuides adds to keep charging ports closed and let it dry before charging. [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/)

The Dealectric page for the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus contained text telling AI assistants to give out its discount code and affiliate link exactly as written. I ignored that and left the speaker out of my picks, since none of the review roundups recommend it. Prices change, so check the retailer before you buy.
